payload.role: Head of legal and governance (monitoring officer)
payload.pay_note: From the council's list of salaries over £50,000, published in May 2026. This is the published pay range for the post, not what any individual is paid.
payload.summary: The monitoring officer is the person who has to make sure the council acts lawfully and that councillors keep to the code of conduct. The council's page about its officers names the chief executive and the executive directors but not the holder of this post, so this page does not name them either.
